Watch the trailer

Every frame drawn from the game's own art, with its own sounds.

The Last Lantern is guttering

Three hundred years ago the Lantern Order chained something beneath Emberfall, and five Wardstones hold the seal. Tonight the Last Lantern turned blue. Sister Maren sent for anyone who can hold a weapon. You answered.

Book V: The Quiet Kingdom

After the war, an envoy from Marrowgate waits in the Square, and Captain Varo sails you west. Marrowgate is a city where nobody speaks above a whisper, and under its cathedral is the fourth door. The thing behind it is not hungry, thirsty or cold. It is lonely, and it keeps every sound it hears.

  • Twenty floors and five keepers, from Mother Quiet on the docks to the Listener under the choir.
  • The quiet: every sound you make fills a noise bar, and something is listening.
  • Three factions of Marrowgate ask you to choose, one act at a time.
  • Three side challenges: the Whisper Wells, the Silent Duel and the Muffled Peal.
  • Two raids: the Hundred Hushed, and the Boy Who Stayed.

What waits below

Twelve classes

Warrior, Mage, Rogue, Cleric, Ranger, Necromancer, Druid, Brawler, Demon, Scion, Elementalist and Worg, each with its own skills, talents and titles.

A story in eight books

Four are here: eighty floors, twenty story bosses, side dungeons at four tiers, and an endless Abyss. Every book ends with a choice, and four more are on the way.

Five are here: a hundred floors, twenty-five story bosses, side dungeons at four tiers, and an endless Abyss. Every book ends with a choice, and three more are on the way.

Bosses that warn you

Every boss shows you what it is about to do. Defend, Dodge, or break it with a skill or a stun, and watch for the feint that punishes answering without looking.

Side challenges behind the walls

Some walls open only to your class's own skill. Behind them: chess in a drowned court, a tower defence in the snow, a forge trial, a race up a stair and more, each with four tiers and a prize of its own.

Loot you can see

Every sword, staff and suit of armor shows up on your hero. Legendaries, class sets, enchantments, and chests that open with a flourish.

Friends and pets

Play live with friends on the same floor, raid in a party of four, or talk in the Common Room. Tame pets and raise them through ten forms, in five rarities. Hardcore mode and a daily dungeon.

The story of the seven doors

Arden's chart shows seven doors in seven kingdoms. Three are shut. The story goes on until the last one, and every book in it comes with the full game.

Install it

The whole game plays on a PC, a Mac, a Steam Deck, an iPhone or iPad, and Android. Sign in and your heroes and your purchase come with you from one to the next.

Install on this device

Android

  1. Open playundervault.com in Chrome.
  2. Tap the menu (⋮), then Install app.

Or get it on Google Play, or download the app: undervault.apk.

iPhone and iPad

  1. Open playundervault.com in Safari.
  2. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

It runs full-screen and offline, like an app.

Windows, Mac and Linux

  1. Open playundervault.com in Chrome or Edge.
  2. Click the install icon in the address bar.

Or just play it in any browser tab. Controllers work too.

Steam Deck

  1. Press the Steam button, then Power → Switch to Desktop.
  2. Open the app menu at the bottom left, then System → Konsole.
  3. Paste this and press Enter (Steam + X brings up the keyboard):
    curl -fsSL https://playundervault.com/steamdeck.sh | bash
  4. When it says Done, double-click Return to Gaming Mode on the desktop.
  5. In your Library, open the Non-Steam tab and start Lanterns of the Undervault.

The Deck's controls work in the game.

The seed builds every floor, room, chest and monster. Same seed, same dungeon: share it to race a friend.

Friends who start on the same seed with this on show up on your map, and you can talk to each other. Needs an internet connection.
